title: Catalog configuration
statement: Given a natural number $k$, a state type $S$, a Boolean input string $x$, a state $q\in S$, a list $w$ of Boolean words indexed by the $k$ work tapes, and integer head positions for those tapes, define a configuration on input $x$ using state $q$ and the words $w$, with the specified head positions. Its other configuration data are those supplied by the configuration formed from $q$ and $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ assigns a Boolean list to each of the $k$ tapes
integer head positions are specified for each tape
caveat: The referenced constructor Cfg.ofWords is not included in the supplied definitions, so its exact choices for the remaining configuration fields cannot be stated.
